name: Examination Building
shortDescription: Central examination control and administrative office.
fullDescription: The Examination Building is the central hub for all university examination activities. It houses the Controller of Examinations office, exam paper processing sections, and result publication departments. Students visit here for exam-related queries, revaluation applications, and transcript requests. The building is equipped with modern facilities to handle large-scale examination operations efficiently.

name: Central Library
shortDescription: Main university library with vast collection of books and digital resources.
fullDescription: The Central Library is a treasure house of knowledge spanning multiple floors with over 100,000 books, journals, and research papers. It features 24/7 reading halls, individual study carrels, group discussion rooms, and a state-of-the-art digital library section with access to international databases and e-journals. The library also hosts regular book exhibitions, research workshops, and provides Wi-Fi connectivity for students.

name: One Auditorium
shortDescription: Modern auditorium for seminars, conferences and cultural events.
fullDescription: One Auditorium is a state-of-the-art venue designed for academic conferences, seminars, workshops, and cultural programs. With a seating capacity of over 1000 people, it features advanced audio-visual equipment, comfortable tiered seating, excellent acoustics, and professional stage lighting. The auditorium regularly hosts university convocations, guest lectures by eminent personalities, student cultural festivals, and inter-university competitions.

name: Bhuvana Auditorium
shortDescription: Elegant auditorium for departmental events and gatherings.
fullDescription: Bhuvana Auditorium is an elegant and well-maintained venue perfect for departmental seminars, student presentations, cultural events, and small-scale conferences. With a cozy seating arrangement for 400 people, it offers intimate ambiance combined with modern presentation technology including projectors, sound systems, and recording facilities. The auditorium is a popular choice for faculty development programs and student club activities.

name: Mandakini Hostel
shortDescription: Comfortable girls hostel with modern amenities and security.
fullDescription: Mandakini Hostel is a well-maintained girls' hostel providing safe and comfortable accommodation for female students. The hostel features spacious rooms, 24/7 water supply, Wi-Fi connectivity, a common TV room, indoor games facility, and a hygienic dining hall. Round-the-clock security with CCTV surveillance ensures student safety. The hostel also has a beautiful garden area where students can relax and socialize.

name: GYM
shortDescription: Fully equipped fitness center for students and staff.
fullDescription: The University Gymnasium is a modern fitness facility equipped with the latest exercise machines, free weights, cardio equipment, and strength training stations. Professional trainers are available to guide students through workout routines. The gym features separate timing for men and women, locker rooms, and shower facilities. Regular fitness workshops and health awareness programs are conducted to promote student wellness.

name: Pinakini Hostel
shortDescription: Well-furnished boys hostel with all essential facilities.
fullDescription: Pinakini Hostel offers comfortable and affordable accommodation for male students. The hostel provides well-furnished rooms with adequate ventilation, 24-hour water and electricity supply, high-speed Wi-Fi, a common recreation room with TV and indoor games, and a spacious dining hall serving nutritious meals. The hostel has a dedicated warden, maintenance staff, and security personnel ensuring a conducive living environment for academic excellence.

name: SKU Administrative Building
shortDescription: Main administrative headquarters of the university.
fullDescription: The SKU Administrative Building is the nerve center of the university, housing the Vice-Chancellor's office, Registrar's office, Finance department, Academic planning cell, and other key administrative divisions. This iconic building handles all university governance, policy decisions, affiliations, and academic regulations. The building features modern office infrastructure, meeting halls, and visitor reception areas. All important university notifications and circulars originate from here.

name: Department of Chemistry Block
shortDescription: Advanced chemistry laboratories and research facilities.
fullDescription: The Department of Chemistry Block houses state-of-the-art laboratories for organic, inorganic, physical, and analytical chemistry. It features advanced instrumentation labs with equipment like NMR spectrometers, HPLC systems, and gas chromatographs. The department conducts cutting-edge research in areas including nanomaterials, drug design, and environmental chemistry. Students benefit from well-equipped practical labs, a dedicated research wing, and a departmental library.

name: Arts Block
shortDescription: Hub for humanities, languages, and social sciences departments.
fullDescription: The Arts Block is home to various humanities and social science departments including English, Telugu, Hindi, History, Economics, Political Science, and Sociology. The building features spacious classrooms, seminar halls, language laboratories, and faculty offices. Students engage in vibrant academic discussions, cultural activities, and literary events. The Arts Block also houses a departmental library with an extensive collection of literature and research materials.

name: MBA Hostel
shortDescription: Dedicated hostel for management studies students.
fullDescription: The MBA Hostel provides premium accommodation exclusively for students pursuing management studies. Rooms are well-appointed with modern furniture, study tables, and high-speed internet connectivity essential for business research and projects. The hostel features a conference-style common room where students conduct mock presentations and group discussions. Special facilities include a business library corner and networking lounge for aspiring managers.

name: DSR YSR UG and PG Examinations
shortDescription: Examination processing center for undergraduate and postgraduate courses.
fullDescription: The DSR YSR UG and PG Examinations center handles all examination-related activities for undergraduate and postgraduate programs. This includes exam form processing, hall ticket generation, answer sheet management, result compilation, and mark sheet distribution. The center employs modern computerized systems for efficient and transparent examination management. Students can visit for duplicate mark sheets, migration certificates, and academic verification services.

name: S.K. Institute of Management (SKIM)
shortDescription: Premier management institute offering MBA and research programs.
fullDescription: S.K. Institute of Management (SKIM) is a premier business school offering MBA programs with specializations in Marketing, Finance, HR, and Operations. The institute features smart classrooms, a well-stocked management library, computer labs with business analytics software, and a corporate-style conference hall. Regular industry interaction sessions, guest lectures by business leaders, and internship opportunities provide students with practical exposure to the corporate world.

name: SKU Hospital
shortDescription: University health center providing medical care to students and staff.
fullDescription: SKU Hospital is a well-equipped healthcare facility serving the university community. It provides free medical consultation, basic diagnostic services, emergency care, and pharmacy services to students, faculty, and staff. The hospital has separate wards for male and female patients, a 24/7 emergency unit, ambulance service, and visiting specialist doctors. Regular health check-up camps and awareness programs on various health issues are organized for student welfare.

name: Main Gate SKU (Entry Point)
shortDescription: Grand main entrance to the university campus.
fullDescription: The Main Gate of SKU is the primary entry point to the sprawling university campus. This iconic landmark welcomes students, faculty, and visitors with its impressive architecture and beautifully landscaped surroundings. The gate features security checkpoints, visitor registration facilities, and information boards displaying campus maps and important announcements. The area around the main gate is a popular meeting point for students and has easy access to public transportation.

name: Science Block III
shortDescription: Advanced science laboratories and research centers.
fullDescription: Science Block III is a modern facility housing advanced research laboratories for various science disciplines. The building features well-equipped labs for physics, electronics, and instrumentation with cutting-edge equipment. Research scholars and postgraduate students conduct experiments and projects in specialized areas. The block also includes smart classrooms, a departmental library, and faculty research rooms fostering scientific innovation and discovery.

name: Engineering College
shortDescription: Comprehensive engineering education with modern labs and workshops.
fullDescription: The Engineering College offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various engineering disciplines including Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering. The campus features well-equipped laboratories, advanced workshops, computer centers with latest software, and a dedicated research and development cell. Students benefit from industry collaborations, internship opportunities, and placement training programs. The college also hosts technical symposiums and innovation challenges regularly.

name: College of Pharmaceutical Sciences
shortDescription: Premier pharmacy college with advanced research facilities.
fullDescription: The College of Pharmaceutical Sciences is a leading institution offering programs in pharmacy education and research. The college features advanced pharmaceutical labs, a drug research center, medicinal plant garden, and a pilot manufacturing plant for hands-on training. Students learn about drug formulation, quality control, pharmacology, and clinical pharmacy. The institution has collaborations with pharmaceutical industries providing internship and placement opportunities for students.

name: Tungabhadra Hostel
shortDescription: Spacious boys hostel with excellent living facilities.
fullDescription: Tungabhadra Hostel provides comfortable and spacious accommodation for male students. The hostel features well-ventilated rooms, study areas, 24-hour water supply, Wi-Fi connectivity, and recreational facilities including a common room with TV and indoor games. The dining hall serves hygienic and nutritious meals. The hostel environment promotes academic focus while encouraging healthy social interaction among students from diverse backgrounds.

name: Law Department
shortDescription: Comprehensive legal education with moot court and legal aid cell.
fullDescription: The Law Department offers comprehensive legal education through LLB and LLM programs. The department features a fully functional moot court for practice sessions, a well-stocked law library with legal journals and case reports, and smart classrooms for interactive learning. Students participate in national-level moot court competitions, legal aid camps, and internship programs with practicing advocates and law firms. The department also runs a legal aid clinic serving the local community.

name: Incubation Center
shortDescription: Startup incubation hub fostering innovation and entrepreneurship.
fullDescription: The Incubation Center is a dynamic startup ecosystem within the university designed to nurture student entrepreneurs and innovative ideas. It provides mentoring support, seed funding assistance, co-working spaces, high-speed internet, and access to industry experts. Regular workshops on business planning, pitch deck preparation, and investor networking are conducted. The center has successfully incubated several student startups that have gone on to receive external funding and recognition.

name: Science Block
shortDescription: Main science facility with multiple department laboratories.
fullDescription: Science Block serves as the primary facility for various science departments. It houses well-equipped laboratories for Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, and interdisciplinary research. The building features spacious lecture halls with modern teaching aids, computer labs, and research facilities. Students have access to laboratory equipment for practical experiments and research projects. The block also hosts regular science exhibitions and inter-departmental seminars promoting scientific temperament.

name: University Stadium
shortDescription: Grand sports stadium for athletic events and competitions.
fullDescription: The University Stadium is a magnificent sports facility featuring a 400-meter athletic track, football field, cricket pitch, and spectator galleries. The stadium hosts inter-university sports meets, annual athletic championships, and regional sports events. It includes pavilions, changing rooms, equipment storage, and a gymnasium for athletes. The stadium promotes sports excellence and has produced many university-level and state-level champions across various athletic disciplines.

name: Department of Computer Science
shortDescription: Modern computing labs and software development training center.
fullDescription: The Department of Computer Science is a hub of technology education offering programs in computer science and applications. The department features state-of-the-art computer laboratories with high-end systems, latest software tools, and high-speed internet. Students learn programming languages, web development, database management, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. The department conducts hackathons, coding competitions, and industry collaboration programs preparing students for successful IT careers.

name: Department of Physical Education
shortDescription: Center for sports education, training, and physical wellness.
fullDescription: The Department of Physical Education promotes sports culture and physical wellness among students. It offers physical education programs and training in various sports including volleyball, basketball, kabaddi, kho-kho, badminton, and athletics. The department has qualified coaches, indoor sports facilities, a fitness center, and maintains the university playgrounds and sports infrastructure. Regular yoga camps, fitness workshops, and inter-collegiate tournaments are organized throughout the year.

name: SKU SBI Bank
shortDescription: State Bank of India branch on campus for student and staff banking.
fullDescription: The SKU SBI Bank branch provides convenient banking services to students, faculty, and staff within the university campus. Services include savings accounts, education loan processing, scholarship disbursement, fee payment collection, ATM facility, and digital banking support. The branch handles all university financial transactions and provides special student-friendly banking schemes. It's an essential facility ensuring easy access to banking without leaving the campus.

name: Vadavathi Hostel
shortDescription: Well-maintained student hostel with modern amenities.
fullDescription: Vadavathi Hostel offers quality accommodation with all essential facilities for students. The hostel features clean and comfortable rooms, 24-hour water and electricity, Wi-Fi connectivity, a common entertainment room, and a hygienic mess facility. The hostel administration ensures strict discipline while maintaining a friendly atmosphere. Regular cultural and sports activities are organized within the hostel to promote holistic development and community bonding among residents.

name: Central Mess SKU
shortDescription: Central dining facility serving hygienic meals to students.
fullDescription: The Central Mess is the primary dining facility serving nutritious and hygienic meals to hundreds of students daily. The spacious dining hall operates on a systematic schedule providing breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner. The menu is designed by nutritionists ensuring balanced and varied meals. The mess maintains high cleanliness standards with a modern kitchen equipped with industrial-grade cooking equipment. Special meals are prepared during festivals and celebrations.

name: Girls Hostels
shortDescription: Secure and comfortable residential complex for female students.
fullDescription: The Girls Hostels complex provides safe, secure, and comfortable accommodation for female students. The facility features well-furnished rooms, round-the-clock security with CCTV surveillance, biometric entry systems, and female wardens. Amenities include Wi-Fi connectivity, common study rooms, recreation areas, indoor games, and a hygienic dining hall. The hostel organizes cultural programs, festival celebrations, and skill development workshops creating a home-like environment for students.

name: Union / Andhra Bank Branch
shortDescription: Union Bank of India branch offering campus banking services.
fullDescription: The Union Bank of India (formerly Andhra Bank) branch on campus provides comprehensive banking services to the university community. Services include student savings accounts, education loans, fee collection, scholarship disbursements, ATM services, and digital banking facilities. The branch handles university transactions and provides special banking schemes for students and staff. Its convenient location saves time for campus residents needing financial services.

name: Mahanandi Hostel
shortDescription: Comfortable student hostel with good living facilities.
fullDescription: Mahanandi Hostel provides pleasant and affordable accommodation for university students. Rooms are spacious, well-lit, and furnished with basic amenities. The hostel offers 24-hour water supply, electricity backup, Wi-Fi connectivity, and a common room for recreation. The attached mess serves quality food prepared under hygienic conditions. The hostel environment encourages academic focus while providing opportunities for social interaction and cultural exchange among students.

name: Ganga Hostel
shortDescription: Well-managed student residence with essential amenities.
fullDescription: Ganga Hostel is a well-managed student residence providing comfortable living spaces. The hostel features clean rooms, adequate bathroom facilities, study areas, and a peaceful environment conducive to learning. Modern amenities include Wi-Fi internet, water purifiers, and recreational facilities. The hostel administration maintains discipline while fostering a supportive community. Regular meetings address student concerns ensuring a smooth and pleasant hostel experience for all residents.

name: Krishna Hostel
shortDescription: Popular student hostel known for its vibrant community.
fullDescription: Krishna Hostel is one of the most vibrant residential facilities on campus, known for its active student community and cultural events. The hostel provides comfortable rooms with all basic amenities including Wi-Fi, clean water supply, and electricity. The common areas buzz with student activities including group studies, music practice, and indoor games. The hostel organizes annual cultural festivals and sports tournaments creating lasting memories and friendships among residents.

name: Botany Block
shortDescription: Department of Botany with research labs and herbarium.
fullDescription: The Botany Block houses the Department of Botany with state-of-the-art research laboratories, a herbarium with over 5000 preserved plant specimens, and smart classrooms for undergraduate and postgraduate students. The department is known for its groundbreaking research in plant biotechnology, taxonomy, and conservation. It features a medicinal plant garden showcasing rare species, tissue culture laboratory, and a museum with botanical exhibits collected from across the region.

name: Polymer Technology
shortDescription: Specialized department for polymer science and technology research.
fullDescription: The Department of Polymer Technology is a specialized center for education and research in polymer science. It features advanced laboratories equipped with polymer processing machinery, testing instruments, and characterization facilities. Students learn about polymer synthesis, processing techniques, material testing, and industrial applications. The department collaborates with plastic and polymer industries providing students with practical exposure, internship opportunities, and promising career prospects in the growing polymer sector.

name: Department of Electronics
shortDescription: Modern electronics labs with circuit design and embedded systems facilities.
fullDescription: The Department of Electronics provides comprehensive education in electronic circuits, digital systems, microprocessors, and communication technologies. The department features well-equipped laboratories for circuit design, embedded systems, VLSI, and signal processing. Students gain hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, function generators, PCB design tools, and simulation software. Regular workshops on emerging technologies like IoT, robotics, and automation prepare students for dynamic careers in the electronics industry.

name: Department of Instrumentation
shortDescription: Advanced instrumentation and control systems training center.
fullDescription: The Department of Instrumentation specializes in training students in measurement systems, process control, automation, and industrial instrumentation. The department is equipped with modern laboratories featuring sensors, transducers, PLC systems, SCADA software, and calibration equipment. Students learn to design, operate, and maintain instruments used in industries like manufacturing, chemical processing, and power generation. Industry visits and practical training sessions provide real-world exposure to instrumentation applications.

name: NTR Bhavanam Office
shortDescription: Administrative office complex for university operations.
fullDescription: NTR Bhavanam serves as an important administrative office complex within the university. It houses various administrative departments handling student services, academic coordination, personnel management, and general administration. The building is a key point for official paperwork, approvals, and administrative queries. Staff members are helpful in guiding students and visitors through university procedures. The office maintains all university records and facilitates smooth administrative functioning.

name: Department of Biotechnology
shortDescription: Cutting-edge biotechnology research and education facility.
fullDescription: The Department of Biotechnology is a center of excellence offering advanced education and research in genetic engineering, molecular biology, bioinformatics, and bioprocess technology. The department features sophisticated laboratories with PCR machines, gel documentation systems, fermenters, and chromatography equipment. Research focuses include agricultural biotechnology, medical biotechnology, and environmental biotechnology. Students gain practical skills through laboratory projects, research publications, and industry internships.

name: Canteen
shortDescription: Popular campus eatery serving snacks, meals, and refreshments.
fullDescription: The University Canteen is a favorite hangout spot for students, serving a variety of delicious and affordable food items. From hot breakfast items and South Indian meals to Chinese snacks, sandwiches, and refreshing beverages, the canteen caters to diverse tastes. The spacious seating area buzzes with student conversations, group discussions, and celebrations. The canteen maintains good hygiene standards and is the go-to place for quick bites between classes or relaxing with friends after lectures.

name: Flag Event Area
shortDescription: Open ground for flag hoisting ceremonies and large gatherings.
fullDescription: The Flag Event Area is an expansive open ground used for national flag hoisting ceremonies on Republic Day and Independence Day celebrations. The area accommodates large gatherings for university events, cultural festivals, and student rallies. It features a tall flagpole and a small stage for dignitaries during official ceremonies. The ground also serves as a practice area for marching contingents and cultural performance rehearsals. The space symbolizes the university's patriotic spirit and community unity.

name: Polymer Science Seminar Hall
shortDescription: Specialized seminar hall for polymer science presentations and conferences.
fullDescription: The Polymer Science Seminar Hall is a dedicated venue for academic presentations, research symposiums, and guest lectures in the field of polymer technology. Equipped with modern presentation technology including projectors, audio systems, and video conferencing facilities, it hosts departmental seminars, student project presentations, and industry interaction sessions. The hall provides an excellent platform for knowledge sharing between students, researchers, and industry experts in polymer science.

name: Department of Library Science
shortDescription: Professional library and information science education center.
fullDescription: The Department of Library Science (also called Library and Information Science) offers professional education in managing libraries, information systems, and knowledge resources. Students learn about cataloging, classification, digital library management, information retrieval systems, and archival techniques. The department features a specialized library with professional resources and computer labs with library management software. Graduates pursue careers as librarians, information officers, and knowledge managers in academic and corporate settings.
